title: Why Do You Weigh Less at the Equator?
topic: Why you would weigh less on the equator than the poles
description: Learn how Earth's rotation and equatorial bulge combine to make you weigh slightly less at the equator than at the poles. Discover how centrifugal force and distance from Earth's center affect your weight on a scale. Subscribe and follow us for more.
